# Skills

Reusable automation skills for Copilot-assisted workflows.

## Purpose

Provide reusable workflow packs that agents can apply across tasks.

## Contents

- Environment Preflight: `.github/skills/environment-preflight/SKILL.md`

## Source of truth boundary

- Keep skill docs workflow-oriented and reusable.
- Keep coding standards in `.github/instructions/*`.
- Keep high-level index links in `.github/README.md` and `.github/copilot-workflow-guide.md`.
- Keep this file short and index-focused to avoid duplicating detailed guidance.

## Notes

- Keep skill execution detail in each `SKILL.md` file.
